**1.58h**

I used Onshape to create a CAD for a case that would hold the starbie, with corner supports so that centeral electrical components have space. Additionally, I also accounted for picking up, so I pentagonally shaped the case so that it wouldn't be like taking pringles out of a pringles can.

### 2026-10-11: i modeled a lid for my starbie case, leaving an additional extrusion for the lid to fit on better, with an additional 1mm tolerance so the lid isn't too tight. I also used onshape's revolve to create

**3.23h**

i modeled a lid for my starbie case, leaving an additional extrusion for the lid to fit on better, with an additional 1mm tolerance so the lid isn't too tight. I also used onshape's revolve to create a handle that has an awfully close resemblance to a pot lid's handle, but whatever.

![img_13](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/iPQiPBB3YAqPu4RFe838ZhRAebDnRFaL/acf37b4adf02ae5a8e5017756c5226065dedd88ba99dc3b22b20478862e2f5a6.png)

I also spent a lot of time making the bill of materials, as i have never done this before. (hence the 1 hour addition on top of timelapses was unrecorded searching as well)

I also fixed a critical wiring issue, which had a problem as the resistor was blocking the usb port for the xiao, by slightly expanding the star. luckily, my onshape case had enough tolerance that i didn't need to remodel the whole thing
